description: This PHP class 'EmployeeEducation' is part of the OrangeHRM system, within the report filter fields. It implements filtering logic related to employee education data, including methods for modifying query builders based on filter criteria, retrieving entity aliases, and converting filter values to an array representation.

classes.name: EmployeeEducation
classes.description: A filter field class for handling employee education data in reports, enabling filtering by education level or qualification.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Modifies the query builder to add a condition filtering employees based on their education, if the operator is EQUAL and the filter value is set.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns array of entity aliases used in the query, in this case ['education'].

methods.name: toArrayXValue
methods.description: Converts the current filter value (education ID) into an array with label and id, retrieving education details using EducationService.
